# Your title

A Roadmap entry is a direction that has not been adopted. It uses the same page kinds as a Feature, and every example is expected output. Implementation and tests do not point at it; `concord roadmap start` moves the directory into `docs/feature/` when it is adopted.

## Who It Is For

Describe who would use this direction and the problem it addresses.

## What You Could Do

List the capabilities this direction would provide, in the user's language.

## Scope

State the final boundary of this direction, including what it deliberately excludes.
